reviews.text: Great place, Snow left very happy

Very friendly team. Excellent welcome!
Pleasant premises. Complimentary coffee 😉
Chrystal was our Shih Tzu Booster's (6.5 months old) grooming service. A very nice cut, exactly as requested.
The whole team took great care of him, giving him a tour of the facilities and offering him a relaxing moment in the ball pit before his service. He quickly felt right at home!
We will definitely be back.
Fantastic find! Top-notch staff, my dog ​​came back looking beautiful and clean, I'll definitely be back!

Excellent grooming salon! My dog ​​was greeted with great kindness and professionalism.

The haircut is perfect, and he left clean, relaxed, and happy.

A passionate team that I highly recommend. Thank you for the great work! 🐶✂️😊

Rocky and Angelo

My dog ​​loved his day and came home exhausted! Fantastic!
The staff are very friendly, our pets are in good hands!
The atmosphere was lovely, the girls were extremely kind and attentive. My dog ​​Boubou felt very happy at Barbett's! 🥰🐶 I highly recommend it!
My little Spitz has never been so well groomed. The welcome was fantastic, very warm. Everyone was very gentle and kind to my dog.

I was able to leave my dog ​​Vignette at Barbett's yesterday, at the dog daycare. Everything went wonderfully; I received a very warm welcome and had the chance to chat with one of the two managers. She took an interest in my dog ​​right away; you can feel their love for dogs. Vignette had three long walks, she was with another dog all day, and I was able to get photos and videos of the day! She was exhausted by the evening, which is a very good sign :)
A fantastic experience at Barbett's! 👌 I highly recommend them. My dog ​​came out looking great and the team was very welcoming; plus, they spoke English if needed! Thank you so much!
A warm welcome; I highly recommend Barbett for his daycare and osteopath. Top-notch parenting advice.
The team was lovely. I have an older pinscher who is terrible for nail trimming. The groomer did a fantastic job. Plus, the atmosphere is a world apart from typical groomers. You feel right at home.

A wonderful grooming experience for my dog, who really needed it! A perfect, meticulous cut, and the groomer took her time (2 hours) to do everything properly. It was such a joy to give her kisses; she smells amazing!

My little Shetland pony, Olly, got groomed today. Everything went perfectly! The girls are super cool and professional! I 100% recommend them! The place is very cozy and clean, and there's even a dog area if you need to leave your dog for a few hours! In short, 5/5!

A huge thank you to the entire Barbett team! 🌸

My 13-year-old dog is unfortunately paralyzed in her hind legs, which inevitably makes grooming more challenging. However, she was welcomed with incredible kindness, gentleness, and patience.

The grooming is absolutely impeccable despite her disability. The staff are lovely, welcoming, attentive, and very professional.

It's truly reassuring to be able to entrust your pet to such caring and attentive people. I highly recommend them! ❤️🐶
A superb place that offers services perfectly suited to dogs and their sensitivities, I left very satisfied!
I highly recommend it! I'm lucky enough to know Sakina, the co-owner of Barbett, who is wonderful with animals and always takes excellent care of them. I can't recommend this salon enough!

A passionate team, deeply committed to animal welfare, all in a welcoming and pleasant environment.

A huge thank you to the team for their kindness and flexibility; I will definitely be back :)

A wonderful discovery: Barbett is a place where you can feel that the well-being and respect of animals are their top priorities!

The welcome is warm and the team is very attentive.
A place I highly recommend to anyone looking for a trustworthy place to care for their companion 🐶

Boune, our little Pyrenean Shepherd, loves going to Barbett's! She's always happy to arrive and comes back well-fed. You can tell the team really takes great care of the dogs, and it's a pleasure to be able to leave her there with complete confidence. A very good experience, I highly recommend it!
Excellent 👌 …

A recap of my experience this afternoon:
I treated my beagle to a grooming session and a day of settling-in at the daycare. The staff took excellent care of him, and this immersion proved very successful.

I recommend this establishment for its expertise and the fresh touch that Barbett brings to the Lyon scene.

My Australian Shepherd had his first grooming session at this salon, and he's usually quite timid. So I stayed in the waiting room during the appointment. The groomer was very patient, gentle, and attentive, which made everything go perfectly. 🥰 My dog ​​came out looking beautiful, squeaky clean, and smelling amazing!

A wonderful first experience! 🐶✨
A wonderful discovery! The welcome is extremely warm and attentive. They have a really nice selection of products for our furry friends.

We are thrilled with our puppy Brooklyn's haircut 🐶🥰 It was her first grooming session and we loved the result!

The groomers were so welcoming and friendly. They took such good care of her, and the final result is truly beautiful. ✨

A wonderful experience, we'll definitely be back! ❤️

My Pomeranian has never looked so good! A wonderful welcome at this new salon where they offered us a coffee. The groomer took the time to understand what we wanted. We felt really comfortable there 😍 …

A really lovely salon with reassuring professionals. I was a little worried after seeing one of the negative reviews. I decided to try it anyway, out of curiosity and for convenience (I didn't have time to find another salon at the time). Honestly, I was pleasantly surprised and reassured about the quality of the salon. Thank you so much!

I tried this salon on a friend's recommendation, and honestly, I wasn't disappointed! The place is gorgeous, bright, and spotlessly clean. The welcome is incredibly warm, and the team really takes the time to reassure our fur babies before starting. As the mother of a 2-year-old Pomeranian, my little guy, who's usually quite stressed by baths (and especially the dreaded hairdryer), remained surprisingly calm. The grooming is impeccable, the scissor cut is very clean, and he smells divine! It's a bit more expensive than usual, but the results are worth it, so if it's within your budget, go for it without hesitation.

I wholeheartedly recommend this osteopath! I came for my aging dog, hoping to get him osteopathic treatment to relieve his stiffness.
From the moment we arrived, the welcome was exceptionally warm and caring. The practice is superb: clean and modern. As for Emilie, the osteopath, she is very professional. She is incredibly gentle, a great listener, and remarkably patient with older dogs. She took the time to analyze my dog's gait. My dog ​​left feeling relaxed! A huge thank you for this excellent treatment.

My dog ​​was delighted with his visit to Barbett's; he had fun as soon as he arrived. He also enjoyed a gentle osteopathy session with Charlotte, whom I highly recommend. The premises are clean and pleasant, as are the staff.

A huge thank you to Charlotte, Barbett's osteopath! The practice is spotless and beautiful. She was incredibly gentle and patient with my dog, who left the appointment feeling calm and relaxed. A passionate professional, full of helpful advice, whom I recommend without hesitation!
Thank you for this innovative concept! A breath of fresh air in Lyon for our furry friends. Plus, the team is fantastic and truly loves animals. I highly recommend it!

My collie spent two days at the daycare. The staff were incredibly understanding of my last-minute request! I received some great advice on how to care for my dog ​​during the heatwave. See you soon! :))

More than just a dog grooming salon, BARBETT redefines the concept of a space that combines animal well-being, the bond between owner and dog, and precious moments for our best friend. BARBETT transforms a necessary service into a true care experience.
I came to check out this new shop and found some lovely accessories for my dogs! I'll definitely be back with them for a grooming session!
A superb experience for my Mali trip; the place is welcoming and the staff are very attentive 👍

I came to discover your recently opened establishment, hoping to offer my standard poodle a more specialized service than he usually receives.

My dog ​​is generally groomed for €80, with very satisfactory results. Here, the service cost me €145, for a sadly inferior result.

Before the grooming, I specifically asked you not to cut his whiskers, which are true sensory organs in dogs. You told me that this only applies to cats, yet you cut them anyway. However, this is also true for dogs.

Even more worrying, I picked up my dog ​​who was clearly in pain in his front paws and chest. You mentioned simple fatigue from the walk. However, he is a dog used to walking and running, and such a situation had never occurred before. As I write this review, his condition has not improved, and I will probably have to consult a veterinarian tomorrow.

I am therefore extremely disappointed by this experience. I understand that a newly opened business needs time to develop, but, out of respect for the well-being of our four-legged companions, it seems essential to me to only take on breeds and services that one truly masters.

A fantastic experience for my 5-month-old cockapoo and me! It was his first grooming session, and the welcome was incredible: warm, professional, and reassuring. They offer coffee and treats for the little ones.
We toured the entire facility, which is beautiful! Bandit stayed for half the day: grooming and playtime with his new friends. He looks magnificent thanks to his lovely scissor cut! A wonderful discovery; we'll be back. Thank you for everything.
Excellent grooming for our American Shepherd. A warm and attentive welcome.

A fantastic experience from start to finish! A warm welcome, a team that went above and beyond, and true professionalism. You immediately feel that the well-being of the animals is a priority.

The salon is beautiful, the atmosphere is soothing, and the result is impeccable. Naska left relaxed, happy, and perfectly groomed.

I highly recommend them. Thank you again for your kindness and passion!
Top-notch grooming for my Bichon! Thank you!

Superb space dedicated to dogs.
Dog nursery with a garden 😍
Highly recommended 👌🏻 …
